question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled dashboard widget gallery with install-from-URL, and should installs be ClawHub/package-backed, raw URL-based with strict gates, or kept outside bundled core for now?
rationale: This adds a new dashboard distribution and untrusted-widget install surface, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or decide whether raw URL installs belong in bundled OpenClaw.

options.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Gallery First
options.body: Keep this issue open, require the Wave 1 dashboard stack to settle, then implement gallery installs through package/trust metadata plus explicit approvals rather than arbitrary raw URL writes.

options.title: Allow Raw URLs With Strict Gates
options.body: Permit install-from-URL only after maintainers define source validation, provenance, sandbox, storage, update, and rollback requirements.

options.title: Move Widget Distribution Outside Core
options.body: Ask widget distribution to start as an external plugin or ClawHub experiment until maintainers sponsor a bundled dashboard gallery.

recommendation.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Gallery First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, require the Wave 1 dashboard stack to settle, then implement gallery installs through package/trust metadata plus explicit approvals rather than arbitrary raw URL writes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the merged Control UI plugin-tab/Logbook precedent that this dashboard work explicitly builds on.
